negative_reviews.author: Danny Kargar
negative_reviews.text:
We visited this Japanese restaurant on Saturday and, unfortunately, the service really let the experience down.

The person who welcomed us when we arrived was very friendly and polite, which was a great first impression. However, the girl who took our order was quite rude and made us feel uncomfortable. The person who brought our food also had a very unpleasant attitude.

What concerned us the most was the hygiene. While bringing food to our table, as well as serving other tables, the staff member repeatedly scratched himself. This was very off-putting and, in my opinion, is not appropriate when handling and serving food.

The food itself was actually okay and we had no major complaints about the quality. However, when we visited on Saturday, we also wanted to order cocktails, but they didn't even have vodka available to make them, which was disappointing for a Saturday evening.

Overall, the food was decent, but the service, attitude of some staff members, and especially the hygiene standards really need improvement. Unfortunately, these issues had a big impact on our overall experience.

negative_reviews.author: Somi Shojaee
negative_reviews.text:
I deeply regret choosing your restaurant. The quality of the food was terrible. The female waitress who took our order was extremely rude and showed no respect towards the customers.

What was even more disturbing was the male waiter who was serving the food. His hygiene was absolutely unacceptable. On two separate occasions, I saw him serving food to the table next to mine while he had his hand down the back of his trousers, scratching his backside. It was honestly disgusting and completely inappropriate, especially for someone handling and serving food.

Although the restaurant itself appeared clean, the male waiter serving the food seemed to have no understanding of basic hygiene standards.

I strongly urge the restaurant manager or owner to review the CCTV footage from 20:24 to 20:35 on Saturday, 26 September 2026. You should be able to clearly see what I witnessed, including the waiter putting his hand inside the back of his underwear and scratching himself while working.

Overall, the entire experience was extremely disappointing and unacceptable.

negative_reviews.author: prasenjeet motghare
negative_reviews.text:
Probably applies to takeaway only. Hate to give bad reviews but I think this one is deserved.
I ordered takeaway couple of desserts and when they brought back food- I was told "sorry we don't give ice-cream with takeaway and I don't make rules" and didn't even offer me options to return or money back -so basically I paid 14.40 for small brownie (was dry) and 4 pieces of banana fitters!
I asked if I could get extra tofu in miso soup as my child only eats that (while traveling) and person taking ordered seemed lost. And what l got is half a cup of soup with maybe 4 pieces of tofu- but it was delicious.
It goes downhill from that- I asked if goyzo can be steamed instead of pan fried (which is standard across world/countries I have tried- and again explained that that is how my child eat it. Anyone who has kids may understand). I was told,"No changes in menu" and he snatched menu and said, "you done ordering "?
Oh well. Seat in looked good- and suchi looked good BUT I left felt cheated!

negative_reviews.author: Jamie Neill
negative_reviews.text:
DO NOT GO HERE IF VEGAN!
Had a bad experience here. We’re all vegan and ordered “vegan” food off of the menu. 2 of us were served food covered in fish flakes. When we explained we didn’t eat fish and were vegan, we were told it was vegetarian (which is obviously isn’t). We explained it wasn’t and the food was remade but there was still fish flakes on the table after and we were left feeling distrustful and a bit sick. Neither of us could finish our food. When the waitress came to take our plates and ask if it was okay, we explained what had happened and said we weren’t happy, yet we were still charged full price for the meal. We won’t be coming here again and will be getting in touch with customer services.

negative_reviews.text:
If I could give less than 1 star I would.

I made a reservation the day before requesting a booth table. Host had no idea and sat us elsewhere. We walk in not greeted in a nice manner and waited over 35 mins to not even be offered a drink or even a glass of water so we left. I said to the waitress we’re going to leave and she said that she’s sorry but didn’t offer to try and make us stay. negative_reviews.author: david tapp
negative_reviews.text:
Stopped off alone for a quick bowl or noodles and enjoyed the service, but the food and downstairs seating could have been better.
Nothing was particularly bad, but not the best.
I had the black garlic tonkotsu, which had a nice broth (could have been thicker) but was lacking a little on the black garlic imo. The menma was good, the noodles were well cooked, but the chasui was not great, and I'm not sure why crispy onions were on the bowl.
It was okay overall.
I also had some chicken gyoza, which were tasty but slightly cold. The dipping sauce also just tasted like plain say sauce, which was a bit of a disappointment.
Service was fast and friendly.

negative_reviews.text:
First time visiting with my siblings, we brought in drinks from outside, as we didn’t see the sign on the outside saying no drinks from outside. We were told this by the staff which we understood, we put the drinks away after being told and didn’t bring them out after. However if you are going to impose this rule then at least bring out the water we requested when we ordered the meal. All our food came out but the water didn’t. Nonetheless the food was good the sushi was nice and the beef ramen was good, the chicken however was bland. Looking at other reviews, I can see people had similar issues.

Atmosphere is nice and calm, chill and the decor is beautiful, especially the post stick note wall.

negative_reviews.author: Nikita Patel
negative_reviews.text:
Extremely disappointed in the service we received.  We had a reservation for 6, it took them such a long time to take our order. Once we ordered our bottle of white wine it took such a long time to come.
One of our glasses was cracked and the wine came warm so we sent it back and requested a cold one which took around 30 minutes to come. By this time we were so fed up because NO waiter came to take our order for food or attend to us.

The service overall was practically nonexistent. There seemed to be a huge focus on influencers and people filming with cameras, flashlights, and content setups, while our table was repeatedly ignored. It genuinely felt like unless you were there creating content, you weren’t a priority.

We had also specifically asked to sit at the bar but were instead given a regular table, despite having a reservation. To make matters worse, the bathrooms were disgusting and clearly had not been maintained.

Between the 40-minute wait, cracked glassware, dirty bathrooms, and lack of service, the experience was terrible from start to finish. Would not recommend.

DO NOT GO IF YOU AREN’T AN INFLUENCER.
